response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience in developer tooling (test runners, CI/CD, fluent-asserts), and proven leadership through workshops and open-source projects, but lacks clear evidence of formal people management experience and mobile platform expertise, which are key for this role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI systems, code generators)
Proven track record of technical leadership via workshops, open-source projects, and mentoring
Broad technical stack including mobile (iOS/TV), build systems, and infrastructure automation
concerns: No explicit mention of managing a team or conducting one-on-ones/performance reviews
Limited evidence of leading organizational change or strategic roadmap ownership
Mobile experience is historical (iOS app maintenance) but not current or platform-ecosystem focused
